summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Christina Carlsen static site. All 9 review-request items verified PASS. Tested 13 pages (home, books, about, educators, blog, contact, thank-you, 3 book detail, 3 blog detail) — all return 200 with content. Active nav highlight, demo form submissions (contact + newsletters on home/books), blog category filter, mobile hamburger overlay, and partials injection all working. No JS errors, no console errors.

issues: Section heading is 'Pre-orders' rather than 'Purchase' — content is equivalent (pre-orders pending date). Not a bug, just FYI vs. the spec wording.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/public/css/main.css is 1070 lines — single-file CSS is acceptable for a static site, but consider splitting into sections (base/layout/components/pages) if it grows further.

main.js loads partials via fetch on every navigation (no SPA caching) — small flash where header/footer is missing for ~150ms. Could be acceptable for this premium-feel site or replaced with server-side includes.
Custom cursor is created via JS on every page load; OK but consider disabling on touch devices via media query in CSS to avoid layout overhead (already gated by matchMedia/innerWidth check in JS).

demo form handlers attach via [data-demo-form] — correct. Browser-native required validation still runs first (verified: 'First name' field blocked submission until filled), which is the intended behavior.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this site.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by `serve` on port 3000, exposed at the preview URL. Partials (_header.html, _footer.html) are injected by /js/main.js — always wait ~2s after navigation before asserting nav/footer. Demo forms have native 'required' attributes; fill ALL required inputs before submitting (home newsletter has First name + Email; contact has Name+Email+Message). Blog filter: 6 total cards, filter buttons use [data-blog-filter]; 'For Young Readers' filter showed 1 visible / 5 hidden — works as expected.
